name: Warlock
subtitle: A wielder of magic that is derived from a bargain with an extraplanar entity
multiclassTraits: Gain the Hit Point Die and training with Light armor.

coreTraits.label: Skill Proficiencies
coreTraits.value: Choose 2: Arcana, Deception, History, Intimidation, Investigation, Nature, or Religion

coreTraits.label: Starting Equipment
coreTraits.value: Choose A or B: (A) Leather Armor, Sickle, 2 Daggers, Arcane Focus (orb), Book (occult lore), Scholar's Pack, and 15 GP; or (B) 100 GP

features.title: Eldritch Invocations
features.body:
You have unearthed pieces of forbidden knowledge that imbue you with abiding magical ability. You gain one invocation of your choice, such as Pact of the Tome.


If an invocation has a prerequisite, you must meet it to learn it. Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one invocation with another you qualify for. You gain more invocations at higher levels as shown in the Invocations column.

features.title: Pact Magic
features.body:
Through occult ceremony, you have formed a pact with a mysterious entity. Charisma is your spellcasting ability and you can use an Arcane Focus as a Spellcasting Focus.


Cantrips. You know two Warlock cantrips of your choice. Eldritch Blast and Prestidigitation are recommended. You gain additional cantrips at levels 4 and 10.


Pact Magic Slots. All your Pact Magic spell slots share the same level, as shown in the Warlock Features table. You regain all expended Pact Magic spell slots when you finish a Short or Long Rest.


For example, at level 5 you have two level 3 slots — casting a level 1 spell uses one of those slots and casts it at level 3.

features.title: Magical Cunning
features.body:
You can perform an esoteric rite for 1 minute. At the end of it, you regain expended Pact Magic spell slots up to half your maximum (round up).


Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

features.title: Warlock Subclass
features.body: You gain a Warlock subclass of your choice. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Warlock level or lower. Choose your patron below:

features.title: Ability Score Improvement
features.body: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Warlock levels 8, 12, and 16.

features.title: Subclass Feature
features.body: You gain a new feature from your chosen patron.

features.title: Ability Score Improvement
features.body: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.title: Contact Patron
features.body:
You always have the Contact Other Plane spell prepared. With this feature, you can cast it without expending a spell slot to contact your patron, and you automatically succeed on the spell's saving throw.


Once you cast the spell this way, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

features.title: Subclass Feature
features.body: You gain a new feature from your chosen patron.

features.title: Mystic Arcanum (Level 6)
features.body:
Your patron grants you a magical secret. Choose one level 6 Warlock spell as this arcanum. You can cast it once without expending a spell slot per Long Rest.


You gain additional arcana at levels 13 (lv 7), 15 (lv 8), and 17 (lv 9). Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one arcanum with another Warlock spell of the same level.

features.title: Ability Score Improvement
features.body: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.title: Mystic Arcanum (Level 7)
features.body: Your patron grants you another magical secret. Choose one level 7 Warlock spell. You can cast it once without a spell slot per Long Rest.

features.title: Subclass Feature
features.body: You gain a new feature from your chosen patron.

features.title: Mystic Arcanum (Level 8)
features.body: Your patron grants you another magical secret. Choose one level 8 Warlock spell. You can cast it once without a spell slot per Long Rest.

features.title: Ability Score Improvement
features.body: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.title: Mystic Arcanum (Level 9)
features.body: Your patron grants you a final magical secret. Choose one level 9 Warlock spell. You can cast it once without a spell slot per Long Rest.

features.title: Epic Boon
features.body: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. Boon of Fate is recommended.

features.title: Eldritch Master
features.body: When you use your Magical Cunning feature, you regain all your expended Pact Magic spell slots instead of only half.
